baseline_description: Upstream st 0.9.2; original parent of the first local scrollback patch.
notes: The original fork point is st 0.9.2 (d63b9eb), not the current merge-base 04ce0d6. Upstream fixes were subsequently merged at 405bd3e and fa6e1cb; using the current merge-base would hide the initial scrollback/reflow changes.
Totals since the original fork include both local changes and explicitly identified upstream merges. Side-commit tables enumerate the imported upstream changes.
Generated buildinfo.h is excluded even during the short period it was tracked. boxdraw_data.h is maintained source and is included.
Commit b8e8aa0 is titled merge but has only one parent; it adds build metadata/splash changes, not a Git merge.

changes.405bd3e: Merge upstream st 0.9.3-era fixes through 688f70a into the scrollback/reflow build.
changes.fa6e1cb: Merge upstream async-signal-safe SIGCHLD error handling (04ce0d6).
changes.d01c992: Configure font/colors/geometry and keyboard/mouse scroll bindings.
changes.f04f23e: Ignore synchronized-output mode sequences (not synchronized rendering support).
changes.e1ab2ba: Document patch provenance and ignore build artifacts.
changes.519a104: Handle modern terminal capability probes quietly (DECRQM, kitty flags, modifyOtherKeys).
changes.b35a7d1: Let line editors repaint the active cursor line after reflow; retain output/history reflow.
changes.2628ce5: Recognize OSC 8 sequences quietly; no clickable-link implementation.
changes.62578fa: Advertise scrollback clearing in terminfo (excluded from code counts).
changes.1939b73: Enable the previously ported geometric box drawing.
changes.3d2d0f2: Add manual table-rendering test document (excluded from code counts).
changes.55cff8f: Set opacity to 1.0; add b build/optional-install script.
changes.73d48ab: Enable allowwindowops for OSC 52 clipboard copying.
changes.b21f09f: Track config.h instead of ignoring it; count the effective header only, not both copies.
changes.abb7512: Consolidate docs/patch history, add maintenance notes, revise distribution file list.
changes.b8e8aa0: Generate Git build metadata; include it in splash text, increase timeout, revise packaging.
changes.40552e7: Temporarily track generated buildinfo.h (excluded from counts).
changes.05d9caf: Stop tracking generated buildinfo.h; update ignores.
changes.59a0469: Synchronize effective config.h with updated splash configuration.
changes.50e5603: Normalize paste line endings; add clean-copy/yank actions and shortcut documentation.
changes.72fd354: Add rectangular keyboard selection with Ctrl+v.
changes.79f4ce6: Add word/WORD motions, first/last printable positions, counts and history-row jumps.
changes.db9f6b5: Ship st-copyout/st-urlhandler, clipboard/browser fallbacks and tests; repair install/dist packaging.
changes.b809f33: Align font defaults and make helper menus use dmenu-font when available; test wrapper integration.
changes.86bb421: Add suck multi-project rebuild/update script (support tooling).
changes.80004e5: Exit copy mode/clear highlights after successful explicit copy while retaining clipboard and scroll position; add regression tests.
